$comment: Keeps agents aware of the whole repo, not just root rules. UserPromptSubmit re-injects the context-map reminder every turn (harness-enforced, so it survives long sessions and context drift); SessionStart does it once on startup. Other agents rely on the 'Start here — context map' section in CLAUDE.md.

hooks.command: printf '%s' 'Reminder: CLAUDE.md is a ROUTER. Before acting, load the task-relevant files from its "Start here — context map" (Features.md, TODO.md, docs/tests.md, docs/configuration.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/sandbox-testing.md, skills/*/SKILL.md). Keep docs in lockstep in the same change (Documentation-sync table); CI enforces it. Design before code; TDD; never send real Telegram messages outside the sandbox test account.'
printf '%s' 'This repo follows CLAUDE.md as a router over Features.md/TODO.md/docs/*/skills. Read the "Start here — context map" before working; do not work from CLAUDE.md alone.'
